Maya Patel: Hey support — customer on Dedicated hitting invalid JSON when using response_format=json + strict=true. Only after we enabled streaming/chunked responses for >1k tokens. Correlation: cid=abc-123. Repro attached.
Liam Chen: Can you paste the original curl? headers? streaming flag?
Maya Patel: curl below. Note we set `Accept: application/json` and `Response-Format: json` (client header) and `X-Redwood-Mode: strict`
```bash
curl -i -H "Accept: application/json" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
 -d '{"model":"rwd-beta","prompt":"...","max_tokens":1200,"stream":true,"response_format":"json","strict":true}' \
 https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Maya Patel: Server returns stream of JSON chunks but final chunk has trailing null bytes \x00\x00 which breaks our customer's parser -> failure: `unexpected token`.
Anna R.: That's interesting — we've seen streaming boundary issues with KV cache flush in the runtime patch from last week. It appended a 0x00 sentinel when multiplexing outputs across KV shards.
support-bot: ERROR log snippet (from proxy):
```
[2026-02-10T14:03:12Z] conn=534 cid=abc-123 write: chunked flush len=4096 tail=\x00\x00
[2026-02-10T14:03:12Z] conn=534 close stream status=200
```
Liam Chen: @Anna any quick mitigation we can recommend to the customer? changing headers, disabling streaming?
Anna R.: Workarounds: 1) Turn off stream=true (non-streaming returns single valid JSON) 2) Set strict=false so the API will accept near-JSON (not ideal) 3) Add post-read trim of trailing nulls (client-side). For immediate customer: ask them to toggle stream off.
Maya Patel: Customer says they need streaming for latency. Is there a patch ETA?
Oncall Eng: Escalating to eng-runtime. Ticket RN: INF-4721. Patch in review: strip trailing nulls on final flush and ensure chunk boundaries end with newline only. Deploy ETA 6 hours if review passes.
Liam Chen: Also let's add an integration test: streaming + kvcache + multiplexing -> ensure no 0x00. I'll add a test case.
Maya Patel: Thanks — I told customer we can either disable stream or use strict=false temporarily. They'll try strict=false and report back.
Oncall Eng: Update: deploying hotfix to canary now. I'll post CID when complete.
Maya Patel: Thanks all :pray:
support-bot: Ticket INF-4721 created, priority: P1, owner: eng-runtime
